name: Milhian Occupation
note: Troops of Milhos have crossed into Tamerscomia in the Milhos-Tamerscomian War. They raid, besiege and hold the land here, the richest along the border, and its people flee before them.

name: Berunese Peasant Revolt
note: Crushed by the taxes of Crafia, the people of Berun refuse to pay and have taken up arms against the tax collectors.

name: Asctum Rebellion
note: Asctum has risen against the rule of Fronhas. Its people are strangers to the ruling culture.

name: Beth Proselytism
note: Missionaries of Beth Deities preach among the followers of Angshire Way here, winning converts village by village.

name: Red Cholera
note: An outbreak of red cholera that began in the market of Pevolinhape. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

name: Brown Plague
note: An outbreak of brown plague that began in the port of Seren, brought by ships. Merchants and travelers carry it along the roads.

name: Mount Boline Eruption
note: Mount Boline is erupting. Ash and lava cover the land around it, and people flee its slopes.

name: Herthetonese Avalanche
note: Avalanches have buried the mountain road here. The pass is closed until the snow is cleared.

name: Quatfield Fault
note: A fault line where the ground cracks and shakes with frequent tremors. Few dare to build here.

name: Soutford Flood
note: The Seamerham river has burst its banks at Soutford, flooding the streets and the fields along it.

name: Birburan Tsunami
note: A great wave from the sea has struck this coast, wrecking harbors and drowning the villages along the shore.

name: Freimanilian Hunger
note: The poorest countryside of Freimanilia. The harvest has failed, and its people have no money to buy grain from the markets, so they go hungry.
